title: Natural Frequencies of Marine Drilling Risers

verification_tolerance.statement: Recomputation-equivalence tolerance only. It decides whether a regenerated P43 artifact is the same evidence as the frozen artifact across Python/NumPy/BLAS builds. It is NOT an engineering acceptance or validation tolerance and does not relax any comparison with the published source.
verification_tolerance.rationale: The independent Hermite-FE eigen-solution (numpy.linalg cholesky/eigh) differs across NumPy/BLAS builds. Measured against the frozen evidence under Python 3.10-3.13 with NumPy 2.2.6-2.5.3: eigenvalue changes <= 3.8e-8 absolute; largest change in any percentage column 1.2e-6 percentage points; no text, status or structure change (docs/MUTATION_INVENTORY_v0.2.0.md).

rounding_guards.rule: Every recomputed eigenvalue compared with published Table 1 must keep the same 3-decimal rounded value (Table 1 printed precision).
Published Table 1 eigenvalues must keep the same 3-decimal value.

source.identity_basis: Journal of Petroleum Technology, July 1976. DOI and SPE paper number confirmed by the study owner from the publisher record on 2026-09-27. The earlier source contract recorded the SPE number as 5820 in error.

discrepancies.target: Table 1 alpha=0, beta=200, fifth eigenvalue lambda5
discrepancies.observation: The source visibly prints lambda5=13.221. Independent Eq. (8) FE and Eq. (10) give approximately 18.221, and Table 2 reports zero approximation error for alpha=0.
discrepancies.engineering_interpretation: The evidence strongly suggests a source table typo, likely 13.221 -> 18.221, but EngiProof does not silently correct the published record without an erratum or author/source confirmation.
closure_requirements: Retain the published 13.221 value in source evidence.
Do not substitute 18.221 into the published table record.
Resolve only with authoritative erratum/author clarification or equivalent primary evidence.

discrepancies.target: Table 1 alpha=200, beta=100, first eigenvalue lambda1
discrepancies.observation: The source visibly prints lambda1=6.554. Independent Eq. (8) FE gives approximately 6.654. Eq. (10) combined with 6.654 gives about 1.39% error, matching Table 2; using 6.554 gives about 2.93%, inconsistent with Table 2.
discrepancies.engineering_interpretation: The evidence strongly suggests a source table typo, likely 6.554 -> 6.654, but EngiProof retains the printed source value unless authoritative confirmation is available.
closure_requirements: Do not silently substitute 6.654 in the published table record.
Resolve only with authoritative erratum/author clarification or equivalent primary evidence.

limitations: P43-D001 remains open: Table 1 visibly prints lambda5=13.221 at alpha=0, beta=200, while independent Eq.8 FE and Eq.10 give approximately 18.221 and Table2 reports zero Eq10 error for alpha=0.

P43-D002 remains open: Table 1 visibly prints lambda1=6.554 at alpha=200, beta=100, while independent Eq.8 FE gives approximately 6.654 and Table2 is internally consistent with 6.654 rather than 6.554.
The source power-series coefficient recursion used for Eq. (9) is not fully reproduced in the paper; EngiProof uses an independent Hermite-FE eigenvalue solution instead.
Figure 6 is not digitized. Phase 1 independently checks the first-mode inflection location and qualitative non-trigonometric behavior.

Automated source-identity audit remains REVIEW_REQUIRED because no DOI is found and the 1976 page header is not classified as primary publication-year evidence; no conflicting identity evidence was found.
